verdict.rationale: Granola's Mintlify-hosted API reference includes an interactive playground with a "Try it" button that sends live requests to the public API. It is backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 document, which covers both the interactive-reference and runnable-examples parts of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works; a sandbox or test environment (the FAQ says there is none, so runs hit live workspace data); access for users below the Business plan, since API keys require Business or Enterprise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify-hosted API reference runs the interactive playground ("Try it" button sending live requests to https://public-api.granola.ai with a bearer key)
Granola publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document
Not currently. We recommend testing with a small number of notes in a dedicated test folder.
